question: What immense wealth is imagined as insufficient compared to this teaching?
premises: An ocean filled with jewels is imagined
Someone might possess such an accumulation
This wealth serves as a comparison
inference: Even one who could accumulate an ocean filled with jewels is invoked as a comparison.
uncertainties: The fused form ratnasaṃpūrṇamakretuṃ is difficult to parse precisely.
plain_english: Even if one had the accumulation to make an ocean filled with jewels.
